login.lead: Welcome back. Your conversations are waiting.
login.locked: Too many attempts. Wait {{minutes}} minutes and try again.

twoFactor.title: Two-step sign-in

twoFactor.failed: That code did not work. Sign in again to get a new one.

signup.title: Create your account
signup.lead: One inbox for WhatsApp, Instagram and Messenger. Free during the beta.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.lead: Enter the email you sign in with and we will send you a link.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.lead: After this, every device signed in to your account is signed out.
reset.done: Your new password is ready. Every device was signed out, so sign in again.

verify.title: Confirming your email
verify.done: You can now connect your channels.

invite.title: Join your team
invite.lead: You were invited to a workspace on Setubandh AI.
invite.otherEmail: Invitations work only for the email they were sent to.
invite.switchAccount: Sign in as the invited email

linkProblem.title: This link does not work
linkProblem.reset: The reset link is missing, used or expired. Ask for a new one.
linkProblem.verify: The link is missing, used or expired. Enter your email and we will send a new one.
linkProblem.invite: The invitation link is missing, used or expired. Ask the person who invited you to send it again.
